visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit, spacious exhibition hall during a medical convention. A woman in a professional tan blazer and glasses is seated on a tall stool, actively conversing with another woman wearing a grey vest and a blue lanyard. The background is filled with informational posters and other attendees walking around. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the interactions between the two characters. (2) The scene transitions to the main character, the woman in the tan blazer, walking through the hall while speaking directly to the camera. She uses expressive hand gestures to emphasize her points. The background features a large, open venue with white pillars and blurred figures of other participants. Periodically, a small circular window appears, showing static close-up images of skin conditions and facial scarring on a male patient. (3) The camera provides a macro close-up of a medical procedure being performed on a person's skin near the eyebrow area. A dark, hand-held device with visible needles is pressed against the skin, and small droplets of blood are visible. The main narrator continues to speak, though her face is not on screen during this specific technical demonstration. The setting remains the clinical exhibition context. (4) The final phase is a high-contrast graphic display of the clinic's contact information. The layout is clean and minimalist, featuring the clinic's logo at the top and several icons for social media and location. The text is presented in a dark grey font against a light, patterned background, providing a clear and professional end to the video segment.
